issue.title: Scan agents-sidecar transcripts and prompt files with the core attachment scanner, add GH013 handling, then enable push protection on existing public sidecars

task_type_fields.proposal:
Reuse the core attachment secret scanner (`attachment_scan_file`, sase-core `note_attachment/scanner.rs`, rules v1: known values, credential patterns, env dumps) in the agents-sidecar transcript and prompt-file publishers before they push to the public `sase--agents` sidecar. When a hit is found, withhold or redact the file instead of publishing it.

After that, give the publishers GH013 / "push declined due to repository rule violations" handling, modeled on the attachment outbox's permanent `blocked` state and its hidden-clone reset in `src/sase/bead/attachments/upload/secret_scan.py`. Then enable GitHub secret scanning and push protection on the existing public sidecars (sase-github's `sdd_secret_scanning` PATCH, or the manual `gh api` command in sase-github `docs/configuration.md`). Without the GH013 handling, push protection could stall transcript publication.

Evidence: the sase-1d5.3 count-only scan found 17 of 21,467 published transcript/object files with scanner hits (12 known-value, 2 credential-pattern, 3 env-dump). Only counts were recorded, never values.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by sase-1d5.8 (ga phase of epic sase-1d5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2). The epic scoped the scanner and push protection to the new attachments sidecar only. Human prerequisite 2 of plan:202609/public_bead_attachments.md leaves enabling push protection on the existing sidecars as the user's call, until the publisher can survive GH013.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1d5 built a secret scanner and GH013 handling only for public attachments; the already-public agents sidecar still publishes transcripts unscanned, and its count-only scan found hits.

payload.description: Epic that built the core scanner, GH013 handling, and sdd_secret_scanning for the attachments sidecar only; ga phase sase-1d5.8 proposed this
